title: MathExpressionEvaluator multi-variable (u,v) support
description: Extend the evaluator to recognize u, v (and optionally x, y as aliases) as a two-variable form. Backward compatible - existing 1D expressions with only x still work. Foundation for FunctionFieldNode.
definition-of-done: 1. evaluate(expression, u, v) works. 2. Existing single-variable evaluate() unchanged. 3. All math functions work in 2D context.
testing-plan: 1. sin(u*pi)*cos(v*pi) evaluates at various (u,v) points. 2. Existing function_curve tests pass.
